Start: 1069-05-20  
Add 48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Add 1 more day → total +337 days.  

1069 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
Days from 1069-05-20 to end of 1069:  
May: 31-20 = 11 days left in May.  
June 30, July 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31 → total days after May = 30+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 214.  
So from May 20 to Dec 31 = 11 + 214 = 225 days.  

337 − 225 = 112 days into 1070.  
1070 is not a leap year (1070 ÷ 4 = 267.5).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31 → 31+28+31 = 90 days (Jan–Mar).  
112 − 90 = 22 days into April.  

Result: 1070-04-22.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1070-04-22
